# cmake

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//cmake:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//cmake:defs.bzl", "cmake_library")
```

## Rules

### `cmake_library`

Owns the CMake files of one package for dx format (gersemi) and dx lint (cmakelint). It does not build CMake projects.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | CMake files of this package: CMakeLists.txt or *.cmake. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Other cmake libraries this package depends on. |
